review: I like the bones: Ferry Lines, Crumble Bridge and Gauntlet give me real routing and timing, and the hazards read cleanly. But the curve is broken. Spike Garden is harder than the finale: my mid ghost stood at a ledge for 45 seconds and even the high-skill run gave up at 58%, so I cannot trust the stage. First Steps also stalls a player in front of a spike pair. Saw Mill at 27% is too sharp for stage 3. Spring Loaded is a free 9-second ride with zero deaths, no reason to optimise. Laser Gate kills at 18% in two seconds, which feels like a cycle lottery.
best: Gauntlet and Ferry Lines mix hazards into a route that rewards clean timing.
worst: Spike Garden stalls even the high-skill player at a ledge, so it looks unfinishable instead of hard.
